bild.info_vae: Turns the model's result into visible pixels. Default uses the VAE inside the model.
bild.info_vae_format: The internal format the VAE expects. Auto reads it from the model.
bild.info_clip_skip: Leaves out the last layers of the text encoder: 1 leaves out none, 2 leaves out one. Auto picks by model version.
bild.info_rng: Where the random noise comes from. The same seed gives the same picture only with the same source.
bild.info_weight_type: The number format the weights are loaded in. Smaller formats need less memory and are a little less precise.
bild.info_prediction: What the model was trained to predict. Auto reads it from the model; set it only for a model that is misread.
bild.info_familie: The kind of model. It decides the start values and which encoders are needed. Automatic reads it from the file.
bild.info_guidance: How closely a guidance-distilled model such as Flux follows the prompt.
bild.info_staerke: How much of the input picture is drawn anew. 0 keeps it, 1 draws everything new.
bild.info_breite: The width of the picture in pixels.
bild.info_hoehe: The height of the picture in pixels.
bild.info_schritte: How many steps the model takes. More steps take longer.
bild.info_cfg: How strictly the picture follows the prompt. Higher is stricter.
bild.info_sampler: The method that removes the noise step by step.
bild.info_scheduler: How the noise is spread over the steps. Auto lets the program choose.
bild.info_seed: The starting number for the noise. The same number with the same settings gives the same picture.
bild.info_seed_modus: What the seed does from picture to picture: new each time, fixed, or one up or down.
bild.info_bilder_zahl: How many pictures one press of Draw it makes.
bild.info_lora: Small add-on files that teach the model a style, a person or a thing. The slider sets how strongly.
bild.info_lora_modus: How a LoRA is applied. Auto chooses by the model's weights.
bild.info_embedding: Words learned for the prompt, from the embeddings folder.
bild.info_photomaker: Puts a face from your photos into the picture.
bild.info_adetailer: Finds faces in the finished picture and draws them again in more detail.
bild.info_ad_prompt: The prompt for drawing the faces again. Empty takes the main prompt.
bild.info_ad_negativ: What the faces should not show. Empty takes the main negative prompt.
bild.info_ad_confidence: How sure the detector must be before it counts something as a face.
bild.info_pulid: Carries the identity of a face from a photo into the picture, for Flux.
bild.info_pulid_id_weight: How strongly the face from the photo shows.
bild.info_control_net: Makes the picture follow the shape or pose of a guide picture.
bild.info_control_strength: How closely the picture follows the guide picture.
bild.info_canny: Reads the edges of the guide picture first and follows those.
bild.info_hires: Draws the picture a second time at a larger size.
bild.info_hires_steps: Steps of the second pass. Auto takes the same number as the first.
bild.info_hires_denoise: How much the second pass changes. Low keeps the picture, high draws more anew.
bild.info_hires_upscaler: How the picture is enlarged before the second pass.
bild.info_hires_breite: The width after enlarging. Auto uses the factor above.
bild.info_hires_hoehe: The height after enlarging. Auto uses the factor above.
bild.info_slg_scale: Skip layer guidance for DiT models such as SD3: can sharpen details. 0 is off.
bild.info_skip_layers: Which layers skip layer guidance leaves out.
bild.info_skip_layer_start: At which share of the steps skip layer guidance starts.
bild.info_skip_layer_end: At which share of the steps skip layer guidance stops.
bild.info_live_preview: Shows the picture while it is being drawn. The choice sets how the preview is made.
bild.info_eta: How much fresh noise some samplers add at each step. Empty keeps the sampler's own value.
bild.info_flow_shift: Shifts the steps of flow models such as SD3 or Wan. Empty lets the model decide.
bild.info_sigmas: Your own noise levels for each step, in place of the scheduler's levels.
bild.info_extra_sample_args: Further sampler settings as key=value, passed on as they are.
bild.info_vram_limit: A budget for the graphics memory the weights and working buffers use, in GiB. Empty (auto) uses what is free.
bild.info_offload: Keeps the weights in RAM and moves them to graphics memory only when needed. Saves graphics memory, takes longer.
bild.info_threads: How many processor threads are used. Empty (all) uses one per physical core.
bild.info_split_mode: How the weights are split across several graphics cards.
bild.info_backend: Which device computes which part, for example cpu or vae=cpu.
bild.info_model_args: Further model settings as key=value, passed on as they are.
bild.info_img_cfg: How strictly an edit keeps to the reference pictures. Auto takes the CFG.
bild.info_ref_image_args: How the reference pictures are read, as key=value, for example preset=qwen. Empty lets the model decide.
bild.info_increase_ref_index: Numbers the reference pictures one after the other, in the order given.
bild.info_pulid_embedding: A finished face embedding (.pulidembd) from the PuLID folder. A photo does not work here.
bild.info_sw_circular: Pads the picture round on both edges, so it tiles seamlessly.
bild.info_sw_circularx: Tiles seamlessly left to right only.
bild.info_sw_circulary: Tiles seamlessly top to bottom only.
bild.info_sw_output_format: The format the picture is saved in. Auto saves a PNG.
bild.info_sw_compression_quality: Quality of a JPEG from 0 to 100. Empty keeps 90.
bild.info_sw_qwen_image_layers: How many layers Qwen Image Layered splits the picture into. One more picture comes out than the number.
bild.info_sw_timestep_shift: Shifts the timestep for NitroFusion models. About 250 suits NitroSD-Realism, 500 NitroSD-Vibrant.
bild.info_sw_sampler_rng: The random source of the sampler's noise. Auto uses the RNG above.
bild.info_sw_sample_guidance_schedule: A CFG value per step instead of one for all.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_eta: Adaptive projected guidance: how much of the parallel part is kept.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_momentum: Adaptive projected guidance: how much of the last step carries over.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_norm_threshold: Adaptive projected guidance: the length the guidance is cut back to.
bild.info_sw_sample_apg_norm_threshold_smooth: Adaptive projected guidance: how softly the threshold cuts.
bild.info_sw_sample_slg_uncond: Skip layer guidance on the negative pass instead of an extra one.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_clip_std: LCM: clips the fresh noise at this many standard deviations.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_scale_start: LCM: the strength of the fresh noise at the first step.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_scale_end: LCM: the strength of the fresh noise at the last step.
bild.info_sw_sample_base_shift: Flux and LTX-2 schedulers: the shift for a small picture.
bild.info_sw_sample_max_shift: Flux and LTX-2 schedulers: the shift for a large picture.
bild.info_sw_sample_stretch: LTX-2 scheduler: stretches the schedule towards its end value.
bild.info_sw_sample_terminal: LTX-2 scheduler: the value the schedule ends on.
bild.info_sw_sample_logsnr_min: logit_normal scheduler: the lowest log signal-to-noise ratio.
bild.info_sw_sample_logsnr_max: logit_normal scheduler: the highest log signal-to-noise ratio.
bild.info_sw_sample_resolution_aware: logit_normal scheduler: follows the picture size.
bild.info_sw_sample_lms_max_order: Sampler lms: the highest order, at least 1.
bild.info_sw_sample_lms_shift: Sampler lms: its shift, at least 0.
bild.info_sw_sample_noise_sampler: Samplers that add noise: iid or brownian_tree.
bild.info_sw_cache_mode: Reuses work between steps and draws faster. easycache for DiT, ucache for U-Net, dbcache, taylorseer and cache-dit per block, spectrum for both.
bild.info_sw_cache_option: The cache mode's values as key=value, for example threshold=0.25.
bild.info_sw_scm_mask: cache-dit: one 0 or 1 per step. 1 computes, 0 may reuse.
bild.info_sw_conditioning_cache_size: How many prompt encodings are kept. 0 keeps none.
bild.info_sw_fa: Flash attention in every model, the text encoder too.
bild.info_sw_sage_attn: SageAttention in the diffusion model, CUDA only. Falls back to normal attention.
bild.info_sw_diffusion_conv_direct: Direct 2D convolution in the diffusion model.
bild.info_sw_vae_conv_direct: Direct 2D and 3D convolution in the VAE.
bild.info_sw_linear_scale: Scales the linear inputs. 1 does not scale. Can help against black pictures.
bild.info_sw_attn_scale: Scales K and V in flash attention. 1 does not scale. Needs flash attention.
bild.info_sw_params_backend: Where the weights lie, for example disk, cpu or diffusion=disk,clip=cpu. Turns automatic placement off.
bild.info_sw_auto_fit: Places the weights on the graphics card, in RAM or on disk by free memory. Auto is on.
bild.info_sw_eager_load: Loads every weight at the start instead of on first use.
bild.info_sw_mmap: Maps the model file into memory instead of reading it.
bild.info_sw_disable_prefetch: Does not load the next part of the weights ahead.
bild.info_sw_disable_segmented_compute: Computes the model in one piece even when it is split automatically otherwise.
bild.info_sw_vae_tiling: Encodes and decodes in tiles. Needs less memory.
bild.info_sw_vae_tile_size: In pixels, as WxH or one number. Empty is 256.
bild.info_sw_vae_tile_overlap: How much neighbouring tiles overlap, as a share of the tile. Empty is 0.5.
bild.info_sw_vae_relative_tile_size: WxH or one number. Up to 1 a share of the picture, above 1 a number of tiles. Beats the tile size.
bild.info_sw_force_sdxl_vae_conv_scale: Forces the convolution scale on an SDXL VAE.
bild.info_sw_tensor_type_rules: A weight type per tensor pattern, for example ^vae\.=f16,model\.=q8_0.
bild.info_sw_hires_sigmas: Own sigma values for the second pass, separated by commas.
bild.info_sw_hires_upscale_tile_size: Tile size of a model upscaler in the second pass. Empty is 128.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter: Takes style or subject from a picture. The file lies in the ipadapter folder.
bild.info_sw_clip_vision: The picture encoder the IP-Adapter needs, and Wan 2.1's image-to-video and first-and-last-frame models.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter_image: The picture the IP-Adapter takes style or subject from.
bild.info_sw_ip_adapter_strength: How strongly the model picture acts. Empty is 1.
bild.info_sw_pm_id_embed: The finished face file of PhotoMaker v2 from the photomaker folder.
bild.info_sw_pm_style_strength: How strongly the prompt's style beats the face photos.
bild.info_sw_ad_input_size: The size the detector looks at the picture in.
bild.info_sw_ad_nms: How much two found faces may overlap before one is dropped.
bild.info_sw_ad_max_detections: The most faces the detector finds.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_k_largest: Only the largest this many faces are redrawn.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_min_ratio: A face smaller than this share of the picture is left.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_max_ratio: A face larger than this share of the picture is left.
bild.info_sw_ad_dilate_erode: Pixels the mask grows by. A negative number shrinks it.
bild.info_sw_ad_x_offset: Shifts the mask by this many pixels to the right.
bild.info_sw_ad_y_offset: Shifts the mask by this many pixels upwards.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_mode: none: each face alone. merge: all together. merge_invert: everything but the faces.
bild.info_sw_ad_merge_masks: Redraws all faces in one pass.
bild.info_sw_ad_mask_blur: How softly the mask's edge runs out, in pixels.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_padding: Pixels of surroundings drawn along with each face.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_width: The width a face is redrawn at.
bild.info_sw_ad_inpaint_height: The height a face is redrawn at.
bild.info_sw_ad_denoising_strength: How much of a face is painted over.
bild.info_sw_ad_sort_by: The order the faces are redrawn in.

bild.vorschau_fehlt: There is no preview of the picture yet.
bild.info_preview_interval: How often the preview is renewed. N: every Nth step. -N: only after step N. 0: once after the first pass. Empty: every step.
bild.info_preview_noisy: Shows what goes into the model, still noisy, instead of the denoised picture.
bild.info_taesd: A tiny autoencoder that decodes the TAE preview quickly. It is used for the preview only. The file lies in the taesd folder.
bild.infos_keine: The picture carries no information on how it was made.
bild.modus_unvollstaendig: This needs a finished picture as input, and a detector or an upscaler model.
bild.umwandeln_da: A converted file of this type is already there.
bild.umwandeln_gescheitert: The file could not be converted.
bild.umwandeln_typ: This weight type is not offered.
bild.info_video_frames: How many frames the video has. sd.cpp rounds it down to the model's own step, 33 stays 33, 34 becomes 33. Empty draws one frame.
bild.info_fps: How fast the video plays. Empty plays 24 a second. Some models keep their own rate.
bild.kein_video_aus_bild: This model draws no video from a picture.
bild.info_sw_video_format: The file the video is written as. WebM plays everywhere, WebP is an animated picture, AVI plays in a video player.
bild.info_sw_moe_boundary: Where Wan 2.2 A14B hands over from the high-noise model to the main model. Only acts while the high-noise steps are automatic.
bild.info_sw_vace_strength: How strongly Wan VACE follows the control video.
bild.info_sw_temporal_tiling: Decodes the video a few frames at a time. Needs less memory.
bild.info_sw_tiling_temporal_tile_frames: How many frames one tile over time holds.
bild.info_sw_tiling_temporal_tile_overlap: How many frames two tiles over time share.
bild.info_sw_motion_module: AnimateDiff: turns an SD 1.5 model into a video model. From the animatediff folder.
bild.info_sw_audio: Wan 2.2 S2V: the WAV file the portrait speaks to. From the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_ref_audio: MiniMax-H3: a WAV file the sound of the video follows. From the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_ref_video_audio: MiniMax-H3: the WAV file with the sound of the reference video. From the audio folder.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_steps: How many steps the high-noise model draws. Empty lets sd.cpp split them.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_cfg_scale: The CFG of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_img_cfg_scale: The image CFG of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_guidance: The distilled guidance of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_sampling_method: The sampler of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_eta: The noise multiplier of the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_slg_scale: Skip layer guidance in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layer_start: Where skip layer guidance begins in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layer_end: Where skip layer guidance ends in the high-noise steps.
bild.info_sw_high_noise_skip_layers: The layers skip layer guidance leaves out in the high-noise steps, for example 7,8,9.
bild.video_unmoeglich: This model draws no video. A video needs a video model, or an SD 1.5 model with a motion module.
bild.umwandeln_nicht_kleiner: A copy in this weight type would not be smaller.

editor.anrede_schalter_unter: Shows the greeting and hands the models your name. Off removes both. With cloud models the name travels along.
editor.werkzeugrunden_unter: How often the model may reach for a tool within one answer. Tasks across many files need more; Auto means 50.
editor.befehlszeit_unter: How long one shell command may run, in seconds. Downloads and builds need more; Auto means 120. Agents override it with max_command_seconds.
editor.kontextkomprimierung_unter: How full the context may get before a chat summarizes itself, in percent. Nothing is lost — the history stays readable, the model gets the summary. 1 to 85; Auto means 80.
editor.nicht_geladen: This tile could not be loaded
editor.hf_fussnote: Free token at huggingface.co → Settings → Access Tokens.

werkzeuge.eingebaut_hinweis: Built in, nothing to set up here — the switches next to the tools decide what runs.

eingebaut_satz.run_command: Runs shell commands on this computer — programs, scripts, moving and renaming files.
eingebaut_satz.ask_user: Asks you when a decision is genuinely yours.
eingebaut_satz.memory_save: Remembers something about you or your project, across conversations.
eingebaut_satz.write_file: Writes text to a file, creating it if needed.
eingebaut_satz.edit_file: Replaces one exact passage in a text file.
eingebaut_satz.list_dir: Lists what is inside a folder.
eingebaut_satz.skill_load: Loads a written instruction for a kind of work.
eingebaut_satz.skill_save: Writes down a way of working so it can be loaded again later.
eingebaut_satz.cronjob: Sets up one-off or repeating reminders that fire a task at a set time.
eingebaut_satz.draw_image: Draws an image with the local image model.
eingebaut_satz.deliver_file: Puts a finished file in the dock for you to pick up.
eingebaut_satz.start_job: Hands work to an agent, which runs it in the background and leaves a report.
eingebaut_satz.search_files: Searches the shared folders for text and reports every line it appears in.
eingebaut_satz.create_folder: Creates a folder and shares it as a working folder for this chat.
eingebaut_satz.get_current_time: Reads the current time, the day of the week and the time zone.
eingebaut_satz.goal: Tells you that an agent reached its goal — the report is the message that reaches you.
eingebaut_satz.cron_note: Keeps a short note on a schedule entry, which the next run of that entry reads again.

katalog.keine_kuratierten: No curated models for this kind yet — search above.
katalog.satz_occamy: Qwen3.6 35B A3B fine-tune from Accio, APEX-I MiniPlus build by IsValorum.
katalog.lang_occamy: Mixture-of-experts fine-tune of Qwen3.6 35B A3B by Accio for agentic work: 3B active parameters per token, tool calling, image input, reasoning, 262K context. APEX-I MiniPlus V2.1 quantisation by IsValorum.
katalog.satz_gptoss: OpenAI's GPT-OSS 20B, original weights, with vision and a repaired tool-call template by SoAI.
katalog.lang_gptoss: Mixture of experts from OpenAI: 21B parameters, 3.6B active per token, reasoning always on, tool calling, 128K context. SoAI's V2 build keeps the released MXFP4 weights unchanged, fixes the chat template for clean tool calls and adds image input through an InternVL encoder.
katalog.satz_qwen38: Qwen3.8 27B, quantised to IQ3_S by ISTA-DASLab (GSQ-RCO).
katalog.lang_qwen38: Dense 27B multimodal model from Alibaba's Qwen team, quantised to IQ3_S by ISTA-DASLab with its GSQ-RCO method. Tool calling, image input, 262K context.
katalog.lang_ornith: Dense 9B fine-tune of Qwen3.5 by Ornith AI, trained through self-improvement for coding and agent tasks. Tool calling, image input, 262K context. Q4_K_M quantisation.
katalog.satz_spark: SparkLLM's Spark-X2.5 4B, in the Sharp-Spark build by peculiar-ragdoll.
katalog.lang_spark: Dense 4B from SparkLLM with hybrid attention and a native 1M-token context, strong at coding and agent tasks for its size. Tool calling, reasoning. Sharp-Spark build: imatrix quantisation (Q6_K_XL) and a repaired chat template.
katalog.satz_gemmae2b: Gemma 4 E2B from Google, in Unsloth's 2-bit QAT mobile build.
katalog.lang_gemmae2b: Google's smallest Gemma 4, quantisation-aware trained and packed by Unsloth for mobile-class hardware: 2-bit quantisation (UD-Q2_K_XL), tool calling, image input, an MTP drafter for faster answers, 128K context.
katalog.satz_animaginexl: Animagine XL 3.0 fine-tune from Cagliostro Lab, version 3.1.
katalog.satz_zub_lora: A speed LoRA — usable images in a handful of steps instead of twenty.
katalog.satz_zub_vae: A VAE — turns the model's internal numbers into real pixels, for cleaner colors and detail.
katalog.satz_zub_adetailer: An ADetailer detector — finds faces, hands or people in the finished image and sharpens each one.
katalog.satz_zub_mtp: A speed module (MTP) — runs alongside the language model and speeds up its answers. Goes in the model folder.
katalog.satz_zub_mmproj: Vision — the projector that lets a language model see images. Goes in the model folder.
katalog.satz_emb_qwen3: Qwen3 Embedding 0.6B from Alibaba, GGUF build by the Qwen team.
katalog.satz_emb_nomic: Nomic Embed Text v1.5 from Nomic AI, GGUF build by Nomic AI.
katalog.satz_emb_gemma: EmbeddingGemma 300M from Google, GGUF build by Unsloth.
katalog.satz_emb_bgem3: BGE-M3 from BAAI, GGUF build by GPUStack.
katalog.satz_emb_mxbai: mxbai-embed-large v1 from Mixedbread, GGUF build by ChristianAzinn.
katalog.satz_emb_minilm: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 from Sentence Transformers, GGUF build by Second State.
katalog.satz_asr_qwen3_06: Qwen3-ASR 0.6B from Alibaba, GGUF build by unslothai.
katalog.satz_asr_qwen3_17: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B from Alibaba, GGUF build by ggml-org.
katalog.satz_voxtral_3b: Voxtral Mini 3B from Mistral AI, GGUF build by ggml-org.
katalog.satz_tts_qwen3_17: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz 1.7B Base from Alibaba, GGUF build by ggml-org.
